reviewer: ChatGPT (direct visual comparison of original and staged images)
method: Each original and edited WebP opened and inspected side by side at source display size; compared composition, watermark, legibility, crop, colors, transparency depiction and obvious visual artifacts. GitHub Actions separately verified identical decoded pixels, alpha, ICC profile and encoded image payload.
approval_scope: Metadata-only changes. No correction or endorsement of any existing artwork defect.
